global_curve: Create or remove a live Global Curve for selected or visible Graph Editor curves.
Edit it to reshape every captured curve together.
create: Capture the selected Graph Editor curves, or all shown curves, in another Global Curve.
remove: Remove every Global Curve and all of their live callbacks.
edit: Replace the active Global Curve with a fresh capture of the current Graph Editor curves.
affect_time: Move captured keys in time when Global Curve keys move horizontally.
snap_keys: Round time changes made through the Global Curve to whole frames.
